c1.code:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant L as 领导者 Leader (S1)
  participant F1 as 跟随者 Follower (S2)
  participant F2 as 跟随者 Follower (S3)
  Note over L: 接收客户端写入请求 (cmd=SET k v)
  L->>F1: 1. AppendEntries RPC [Term: 2, LogIndex: 101]
  L->>F2: 2. AppendEntries RPC [Term: 2, LogIndex: 101]
  activate F1
  activate F2
  F1-->>L: 3. AppendEntries OK (Success)
  F2-->>L: 4. AppendEntries OK (Success)
  deactivate F1
  deactivate F2
  Note over L: 达到半数以上确认 (Quorum=2/3) -> 提交日志
  L-->>L: 5. 提交状态机 commitIndex=101
  L->>F1: 6. 下次心跳同步 commitIndex=101
  L->>F2: 7. 下次心跳同步 commitIndex=101
